messages:
maria: Heads up — publish pipeline failed on staging when trying to cut v1.4.0. openapi publish step errored with changelog mismatch.
ci-bot: build #18241 failed at openapi-publish
ci-bot: ```
$ yarn openapi:publish --staging
> Running changelog check...
Changelog check failed: missing entry for version "1.4.0"
Error: ChangelogLintError
    at verifyChangelog (/workspace/ci/tools/changelog.js:42:15)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
``` 
sam: hmm — did the PR include a CHANGELOG entry? I thought the release tooling auto-inserts from PR labels.
maria: it has the label but the PR branch had a pre-release tag in package.json (`1.4.0-rc.1`) so changelog tool didn't recognize final semver.
leo: that matches what I hit yesterday — typegen regen also shows diffs when semver has prerelease. snippet:
leo: ```
- export type OpenAPIv1 = {
+ export type OpenAPIv1 = {
   endpoints: Record<string, any>
}
``` 
anya: CI is flaking because our publish pipeline runs in parallel jobs: one job regenerates typegen and commits, other job checks changelog against tags. race condition if typegen commit lands after changelog check.
jules: we can sequence jobs but that slows pipeline. alternative: make changelog check accept prerelease semantics or detect label->expected version. thoughts?
maria: prefer short term: skip changelog lint in the staged publish if PR has `release/freeze` label. long term: fix the semver detection.
sam: proposal: update changelog tool to accept `1.4.0-rc.*` as matching `1.4.0` when PR has label `release/finalize`. also add a retry on the job that checks for the typegen commit with a 10s backoff, 3 retries.
devex-oncall: I've opened a quick PR to adjust CI: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7543 — it adds a small wait-loop plus accepts prerelease mapping. please review.
jules: added changelog lint tweak to allow `--allow-prerelease` flag; will add docs. :thumbsup:
anya: patch LGTM on my end, but we should add an integration test: simulate PR with `1.4.0-rc.1` and label flow.
maria: thanks all — I'll re-run the staging publish after PR merges. tagging @release-team
sam: FYI, if anyone hits this locally, run `yarn typegen:regen && git add -A && git commit -m "regen: typegen for 1.4.0-rc" && git push` then re-open CI.
maria: copying note into the release checklist. :memo:
